mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4 and increase levofloxacin levels; additionally, turmeric has antiplatelet properties that may potentiate fluoroquinolone-associated tendinopathy risk.
action: Monitor for signs of tendinopathy and fluoroquinolone toxicity; counsel on adequate hydration and avoid excessive turmeric supplementation during levofloxacin therapy.
